<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

  <g filter="url(#shadow)">

  <text x="106" y="286" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Hispanic / Latino</text>
  <text x="284" y="286" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Middle Eastern</text>
  <text x="106" y="348" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Native American</text>
  <text x="284" y="348" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Pacific Islander</text>

  <text x="284" y="410" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">White / Caucasian</text>
  <text x="195" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#4A4A4A">Prefer not to say</text>

    <text x="350" y="759" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#939393">MORE</text>
